1.1.1.gloss_en: Saṃjñā vṛddhi: the vowels ā, ai, au only (SLP1 atoms A, E, O).

1.1.10.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.9: a vowel (अच्) and a consonant (हल्) are never sāvarṇa. Predicate: core.sutra_1_1_10.mixed_ac_hal_forbids_savarna_1_1_10; guard in Varna.is_savarna.

1.1.11.gloss_en: Saṃjñā pragṛhya: in dual, a pada whose last vowel is ई/ऊ/ए/ऐ (SLP1 I, U, e, E). Predicate: core.sutra_1_1_11.is_pragfhya_1_1_11.
1.1.11.gloss_sa: द्विवचने यत् पदम् ई-ऊ-ए-ऐ-अन्तं, तत् प्रगृह्यम्।

1.1.12.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.11: dual **अ**+**म्**+मात् vowel (ī, ū, ā, e, ai) treated as pragṛhya (adas-family intent); surface heuristic until pratipadika metadata gates adas. Use is_pragfhya_pada_1_1_11_or_12 wit

1.1.13.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.11: vocative (vibhakti 8) pada ending in short ए (śi surface śe) is pragṛhya. Predicate: is_pragfhya_1_1_13; combine 1.1.11–13 via is_pragfhya_pada_through_1_1_13.

1.1.14.gloss_en: Saṃjñā nipāta (1.1.14 slice): pada has exactly one vowel and it is short a/i/u. Full nipāta class also uses lists (1.1.37+). Predicate: is_nipata_ekajanang_1_1_14.
1.1.14.gloss_sa: यस्मिन् पदे एकमेव स्वरम् अण्-वर्णं तत् निपातसंज्ञकम् (एकाजनङ्)।

1.1.15.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.11: vocative pada ending in **o** (ओ) is pragṛhya. Predicate: is_pragfhya_1_1_15; combine: is_pragfhya_pada_through_1_1_15.

1.1.16.gloss_en: In vocative, non-Vedic: before following **iti**, Śākalya (vibhāṣā) treats final **o** as pragṛhya boundary (**वायो इति**); others coalesce (**वायविति**). Predicate: is_pragfhya_1_1_16(sakalya_prefer_
1.1.16.gloss_sa: अनार्षे संबुद्धौ इति-परः ओकारः शाकल्यमते विकल्पेन प्रगृह्यः; परेषां मते संधिः (वायविति इत्यादि)।

1.1.17.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.11: nipāta pada ending in short **u** (उञ्) is pragṛhya. Covers 1.1.14 ekājan-aṅ + final **u**, plus listed uñ-anta (e.g. prabhu, sādhu).

1.1.18.gloss_en: Śākalya (laukika): before **iti**, **ū** + anunāsika (ऊँ) or Om-like form is pragṛhya (in place of uñ reading). Predicate: is_pragfhya_1_1_18. **ī**-final in same citation → 1.1.19.
1.1.18.gloss_sa: अनार्षे शाकल्यमते इति-पूर्वं दीर्घानुनासिक आदेशः प्रगृह्यः।

1.1.19.gloss_en: Ī-final and ū-final forms bearing saptamī (locative) meaning are pragṛhya. Predicate: pada-final **I**/**U** with ``Environment.saptamy_artha`` or ``vibhakti == 7``.

1.1.2.gloss_en: Saṃjñā guṇa: the vowels a, e, o only (SLP1 atoms a, e, o); अत् = short अ, एङ् = ए ओ.

1.1.20.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **ghu**: four **dā**- and two **dhā**-type dhātus realised as **dā**, excluding **dāp**/**daip** (1.1.20). Enables guṇa + abhyāsa operations (e.g. **dehi**).
1.1.20.gloss_sa: दाप्-दैप् वर्जित चतुर् दा-रूपा व द्वे धा-रूपा घुसंज्ञकाः।

1.1.21.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: where there is only one unit in scope, both **ādi**- and **anta**-ordered operations apply to it (beginning = end).
1.1.21.gloss_sa: यत्रैकमेव तत्राद्यन्तवद् भवति — आदि-विहितम् अन्त-विहितं च तस्मिन्नेव।

1.1.23.gloss_sa: बहु, गण, वतु-प्रत्यान्त, डति-प्रत्यान्त शब्दाणां संख्यासंज्ञा।

1.1.24.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **shat** (षट्-class): listed ṣ/ṇ-type **saṃkhyā** stems in machine table, with saṃkhyā gate.

1.1.25.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.24: **ḍati**-final **saṃkhyā** padas also get **ṣaṭ** saṃjñā.

1.1.27.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **sarvanāma**: items of the **sarvādi** gaṇa (listed prātipadika stems in SLP1) are pronouns.

1.1.28.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: optional (**vibhāṣā**) application applies in a **dik-samāsa** (directional compound) that is **bahuvrīhi**.

1.1.29.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.27: the **sarvanāma** saṃjñā does **not** apply to sarvādi prātipadikas in a **bahuvrīhi** compound (anuvṛtti **सर्वनामानि** from 1.1.27).

1.1.3.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: when a rule orders guṇa/vṛddhi by those words without naming sthānin, supply इकः (sthāyin ∈ इक् only). Does not apply if sthānin is explicit (e.g. अच्, अतः, आत्) or ādeśa is not by गुण/वृद्
1.1.3.gloss_sa: गुणवृद्धिशब्दाभ्यां विधौ स्थानिनि अनिर्दिष्टे इक्-एव स्थानी।

1.1.30.gloss_en: Niyama on 1.1.27 (with **न** from 1.1.29): **sarvanāma** does not apply to sarvādi members in a compound whose prior member stands in the **third case** (tṛtīyā-tatpuruṣa).

1.1.31.gloss_en: Niyama (extension of 1.1.29–30): **sarvanāma** does not apply to sarvādi members in a **dvandva** compound (**च** adds dvandva to the **न**… scope).

1.1.32.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: optional (**vibhāṣā**) application applies for **sarvanāma** when the **jas** affix is involved (**जसि**).

1.1.33.gloss_en: Saṃjñā extension: **prathama**, **carama**, **taya**, **alpa**, **ardha**, **katipay**, **nema** also receive **sarvanāma** (with **ca** carrying **सर्वनामानि** from 1.1.27).

1.1.34.gloss_en: The stems **pūrva**, **para**, **avara**, **dakṣiṇa**, **uttara**, **apara**, **adhara** are **sarvanāma** in the sense of relative position (**vyavasthā**) when not used as a technical name (**asaṃjñ

1.1.35.gloss_en: The stems **sva**, **am**, **jñāti**, **dhana** are **sarvanāma** when used in the **ākhyā** (appellation) sense.

1.1.36.gloss_en: **antara** is **sarvanāma** when used in the sense of **bahiryoga** or **upasaṃvyāna** (dual locative **-ayoḥ** in the sūtra).

1.1.37.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **avyaya**: **svarādi** gaṇa items and **nipāta** padas are indeclinables.

1.1.38.gloss_en: With **ca** carrying **avyaya** from 1.1.37: a **taddhita** that is **asarvavibhakti** (not taking all cases) is **avyaya**.

1.1.39.gloss_en: **Kṛt** affixes whose form ends in **m** or an **एच्** vowel are **avyaya**.

1.1.4.gloss_en: Pratishedha: when dhātulopa is conditioned by an ārdhadhātuka affix, ik guṇa/vṛddhi (1.1.3) on the remainder does not apply. Predicate: core.sutra_1_1_4.ik_guna_vriddhi_blocked_by_1_1_4.

1.1.42.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **sarvanāmasthāna**: the **śi** positions in the **sup** system (pronoun-specific case–number slots).

1.1.43.gloss_en: Saṃjñā extension: **suṭ** positions in **sup** for **napuṃsaka** are **sarvanāmasthāna** (with **1.1.42**).
1.1.43.gloss_sa: नपुंसकलिङ्गे सुपि सुट्-प्रत्याहारो यः स सर्वनामस्थानसंज्ञकः।

1.1.44.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **vibhāṣā**: **vā** (or **vā**-**iti**) with **na** in the sūtra names optional application.

1.1.45.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **samprasāraṇa**: **yaṇ** semivowels standing for **ik** in the relevant replacements.

1.1.46.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: **ṭit** and **kit** anubandhas mark **ādi** and **anta** as **it** in affix upadeśa.
1.1.46.gloss_sa: प्रत्ययोपदेशे टकारः आदौ इत्, ककारः अन्ते इत्।

1.1.47.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: for **mit** affixes, **it** is the portion after the last vowel of the upadeśa.
1.1.47.gloss_sa: मिति प्रत्यये अचोऽन्त्यात् परो भाग इत्।

1.1.48.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: **ec** is read as **ik** when the operation is **hrasva** substitution.

1.1.49.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: **ṣaṣṭhī** case marks **sthāna-yoga** (relation to substitutional place).

1.1.5.gloss_en: Niyama: when the conditioning affix is kit, git, or nit (engine tags on pratyaya/vikarana), ik guṇa/vṛddhi does not apply. Predicate: core.sutra_1_1_5.ik_guna_vriddhi_blocked_by_1_1_5.
1.1.5.gloss_sa: किति गिति ङिति च परे इक्-गुणवृद्धिर्न।

1.1.50.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: at the substitution **place**, the **antaratama** (most proximate) element is the target.

1.1.52.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: **alaḥ** refers to the **final** (**antya**) vowel or consonant in the relevant unit.

1.1.53.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: **and** (**ca**) **ṅit** — same **antya** scope as **alaḥ** for **ṅit** affixes.

1.1.54.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: the **al** meant is the one **following** (**para**) the **ādi**, not the **ādi** itself.
1.1.54.gloss_sa: आदेः परः यः अच्-हल्-वर्णः स गृह्यते।

1.1.55.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: with **several** **al** and a **Śit** affix, the rule applies to **all** of them (**sarvasya**).
1.1.55.gloss_sa: अनेकेषु अच्-हल्-वर्णेषु शिति प्रत्यये सर्वेषु विधिः भवति।

1.1.56.gloss_en: Atideśa: an **ādeśa** behaves like the **sthānī** for downstream rules, except in **al-vidhi**.

1.1.57.gloss_en: Atideśa: (under sthānivat ādeśa) the **ac** in the rule targets the vowel **following** the prior vidhi’s span.
1.1.57.gloss_sa: स्थानिवदादेशे अच्-निमित्तः पूर्वविधेः परः अच् गृह्यते।

1.1.58.gloss_en: Atideśa: **1.1.56** and **1.1.57** do **not** apply in padānta, dvirvacana, vare, yalopa, svara, savarṇa, anusvāra, dīrgha, jaś, or car **vidhi**.
1.1.58.gloss_sa: पदान्तादिषु विधिषु स्थानिवदादेशः अचः परस्मिन् च न प्रवर्तते।

1.1.59.gloss_en: Atideśa: in doubling (**dvirvacana**), when **ac** is involved (**aci**), **sthānivat** **ādeśa** and **ac** scope (**1.1.56–57**) apply again.
1.1.59.gloss_sa: द्विर्वचने अचि स्थानिवदादेशः अच्-नियमः च पुनः प्रवर्तते।

1.1.6.gloss_en: Pratishedha: for dhātus दीधीङ् and वेवीङ्, ik guṇa/vṛddhi (1.1.3) does not apply. Match: core.sutra_1_1_6.is_didhi_vevi_dhatu / ik_guna_vriddhi_blocked_by_1_1_6.

1.1.60.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **lopa**: **adarśana** — the element is not seen on the surface though it may govern anuvṛtti.

1.1.61.gloss_en: Saṃjñā: **luk**, **ślu**, and **lup** on a **pratyaya** denote its **lopa** (adarśana).

1.1.62.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: when a **pratyaya** has **lopa**, **pratyaya-lakṣaṇa** (affix-keyed rules) still applies.

1.1.63.gloss_en: When **aṅga** is elided by **lu** or **mat**, **pratyaya-lakṣaṇa** (from **1.1.62**) does not apply to that **aṅga** context.

1.1.64.gloss_en: Saṃjñā **ṭi**: vowel class read from the **ac** span **antya**-**ādi** (here: same members as pratyāhāra **ik** in the Māheśvara table).

1.1.65.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: **upadhā** is the **al** immediately before the **antya** **al** in the relevant unit.

1.1.66.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: when a unit is picked out with **iti** (**nirdizwa**), **pūrva** (in **ṣaṣṭhī** wording) means the element immediately before that designated span.
1.1.66.gloss_sa: यत्र इति-निर्दिष्टं तत्र पूर्वशब्दः ततः ईषत् पूर्वम् एकं वदति।

1.1.67.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: when a unit is picked out with **iti** (**nirdizwa**), **uttara** (in **ṣaṣṭhī** wording) means the element immediately after that designated span.
1.1.67.gloss_sa: यत्र इति-निर्दिष्टं तत्र उत्तरशब्दः ततः ईषत् परम् एकं वदति।

1.1.68.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: a word’s **own form** (**sva-rūpa**) is **aśabda-saṃjñā** — not interpreted as **śabda-saṃjñā** (pratyāhāra metalanguage).

1.1.69.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: for **savarṇa**, **aṇ** and **udit** vowels are **apratyaya** (not **pratyaya** anubandhas in pratyāhāra analysis).

1.1.7.gloss_en: Saṃjñā saṃyoga: maximal runs of two+ consecutive consonants (no intervening vowel). Logic: core.sutra_1_1_7 (not a flat samjna_members list).

1.1.70.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: the final **ṭ**-class letter of a **pratyāhāra** is its **it**-marker, fixing the end of the span in the Māheśvara sequence (**tatkāla**).

1.1.71.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: the **ādi** (initial phoneme) together with the final **it**-marker (**antya**) jointly defines the **pratyāhāra** span.

1.1.72.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: when a rule states its trigger in the instrumental (**yena**), the operation targets the form that **ends** in that (**tad-anta**).
1.1.72.gloss_sa: येन विधिः उक्तः सन् तदन्तं प्रति प्रवर्तते।

1.1.73.pcd: वृद्धिः · यस्य · अचाम् · आदिः · तत् · वृद्धम्
1.1.73.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā: if the first vowel (**ādi** **ac**) of a unit is **vṛddhi**, that unit is called **vṛddham**.
1.1.73.gloss_sa: यस्य अचाम् आदिः वृद्धिः सन् तत् वृद्धम्।

1.1.74.gloss_en: Extension: prātipadikas listed in the **tyadādi** gaṇa are **also** called **vṛddham** (anuvṛtti **वृद्धम्** from 1.1.73), alongside units whose first vowel is **vṛddhi**.

1.1.75.gloss_en: Paribhāṣā (Prācya): **e** and **o** (**eṅ**) count as **vṛddhi** for the **vṛddham** test on the first vowel (**1.1.73**).

1.1.8.gloss_en: Saṃjñā anunāsika: mukha+nāsikā articulation — class nasals (SLP1 Y m N R n) + vowels with candrabindu feature. Use core.sutra_1_1_8.is_anunasika_unit / Varna.is_anunasika.

1.1.9.gloss_en: Saṃjñā savarṇa: same prayatna and overlapping sthāna (आस्य). Logic: Varna.is_savarna; class expansion: phonology.maheshvara.expand_savarna.
1.1.9.gloss_sa: यौ वर्णौ तुल्यप्रयत्नौ स्तः तुल्यास्यौ च, तौ सवर्णौ।

1.2.1.gloss_en: Atideśa: for **gāṅkuṭādi** roots, **śap** receives **aṅ**, **ṇit**, and **ṅit** marking for affix-class rules.

1.2.10.gloss_en: **Also** (**ca**) from **halanta**: same **झल्** atideśa as **1.2.9** when the stem ends in **hal**.

1.2.13.gloss_en: **Optionally** (**vā**), **gam** dhātu: same **u**-extension **liṅ**–**sic** **ātmanepada** + **Jal** atideśa as **1.2.12** when not already **u**/**ū**-final.

1.2.14.gloss_en: For **han** before **sic** in **ātmanepada** (with **kit**/**san** anuvṛtti), **ik**/**halanta** + following **Jal** atideśa as **1.2.9–1.2.10** — without **liṅ** lakāra.
1.2.14.gloss_sa: हन्धातोः सिचि आत्मनेपदे कित्प्रकरणे इकः झलि वत्।

1.2.15.gloss_en: For **yam** in **gandhana** (smell-perception) sense, before **sic** in **ātmanepada** with **kit**/**san** context: same **ik**/**halanta** + **Jal** atideśa as **1.2.9–1.2.10**.
1.2.15.gloss_sa: गन्धनार्थे यम्धातोः सिचि आत्मनेपदे कित्प्रकरणे इकः झलि वत्।

1.2.16.gloss_en: **Optionally** (**vibhāṣā**), **yam** in **upayamana** (marriage) sense: same **sic**–**ātmanepada**–**kit**/**san**–**ik**/**hal**–**Jal** atideśa chain as **1.2.15**/**1.2.14**.
1.2.16.gloss_sa: उपयमनार्थे यम्धातोर्विभाषा सिचि आत्मनेपदे कित्प्रकरणे इकः झलि वत्।

1.2.17.gloss_en: **Also** (**ca**): **sthā** and **ghu** dhātus before **sic** in **ātmanepada** with **kit**/**san** context get the same **Jal**-track atideśa as **1.2.14** (no **ik**/**hal-only** stem condition in
1.2.17.gloss_sa: स्थाधातोः घुसंज्ञकेभ्यश्च सिचि आत्मनेपदे कित्प्रकरणे झल्त्वम्।

1.2.18.gloss_en: **Not** (**na**) **seṭ** with **ktvā**: the **dhātu** does not receive **seṭ** saṃjñā before **ktvā** (coordinates **kit** anuvṛtti).

1.2.19.gloss_en: For **niṣṭhā** (**kta**, **ktavatu**), **śīṅ**, **svid**, **mid**, **kṣvid**, and **dhṛṣ** dhātus: **kit** on the **niṣṭhā** affix (**anuvṛtti** **कित्**).

1.2.2.gloss_en: Atideśa: for **vij**, the **iṭ** augment is **ṅit** (inherits **ṅit** marking scope from 1.2.1).

1.2.20.gloss_en: For **mṛṣ** in **titikṣā** (forbearance) sense with **niṣṭhā**: **kit** on the **kṛt** affix (**anuvṛtti** from **1.2.19**/**1.2.18**/**1.2.5**).

1.2.21.gloss_en: From **u**/**ū**-**upadhā** dhātus, **niṣṭhā** in **bhāva** or **karmaṇi** prayoga: **kit** on the **kṛt** affix (**anyatara** of the two prayogas).

1.2.22.gloss_en: For **pūṅ**, the **ktvā** affix is **also** **kit** (**च** extends the **kit** pattern in the **aṅga** context).

1.2.23.gloss_en: Optionally, **no** **kit** for **niṣṭhā** and **ktvā** when the **upadhā** context is **ṭha**/**pha**-**anta** (stem-final **ठ**/**फ** after the **upadhā** vowel).
1.2.23.gloss_sa: ठफान्त उपधाया निष्ठाक्त्वयोः कित्संज्ञा न भवति वा।

1.2.25.gloss_en: According to **Kāśyapa**, **tṛṣ**, **mṛṣ**, and **kṛś** also take **kit** on **niṣṭhā** and **ktvā** (**च** with prior **kit** context).

1.2.26.gloss_en: **Also** for **san**: **r**/**l** in the **vyupadhā** position with **hal**-initial following (**ca** with **1.2.9** **ik**/**झल्** chain).
1.2.26.gloss_sa: संनिमित्ते रलो व्युपधाया हलादौ झलि इवातिदेशः।

1.2.27.gloss_en: **Ūkāla**: vowels (**ac**) in the **hrasva**, **dīrgha**, or **pluta** temporal classes.

1.2.3.gloss_en: Vibhāṣā: for **ū/ṛ**-with-**ṇ** dhātus, **iṭ** may be treated as **ṅit** (extends **1.2.1–1.2.2**).

1.2.31.gloss_en: **Svarita**: the **samāhāra** (combined / middle) pitch accent (on **ac** per **1.2.27** anuvṛtti).

1.4.102.gloss_en: Those three (**tiṅ** forms in each person row) are termed, in order, **ekavacana**, **dvivacana**, and **bahuvacana**.

1.4.103.gloss_en: **Sup** (nominal case) endings receive the same triadic **prathamādhyamottama** and **ekavacana–dvivacana–bahuvacana** designations as **tiṅ** (here keyed from **vibhakti** + **vacana** in **sup_row**
1.4.103.gloss_sa: सुपः प्रत्ययाः तिङवत् त्रैष्टुभेन एकवचनादिभिश्च संज्ञकाः भवन्ति।

1.4.104.gloss_en: **Sup** substitutes receive the saṃjñā **vibhakti**; each allomorph belongs to one of the seven cases (**prathamā** … **saptamī**).

1.4.105.pcd: युष्मदि ७/१ उपपदे ७/१ समानाधिकरणे ७/१ स्थानिनि ७/१ अपि ०/० मध्यमः १/१
1.4.105.gloss_en: When **yuṣmad** is the **upapada**, in **samānādhikaraṇa**, the **sthānin** **also** is **madhyama** (2nd person).
1.4.105.gloss_sa: युष्मद् उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिन्यपि मध्यमसंज्ञकः भवति।

1.4.106.pcd: प्रहासे ७/१ च ०/० मन्योपपदे ७/१ मन्यतेः ५/१ उत्तम १/१ एकवत् ०/० च ०/०
1.4.106.gloss_en: In **prahāsa** (jest), with **manya** as **upapada**, **manyate** is treated as **uttama** (1st person) and **ekavacana** (singular).

1.4.107.gloss_en: When **asmad** is the **upapada**, in **samānādhikaraṇa**, the **sthānin** **also** is **uttama** (1st person).
1.4.107.gloss_sa: अस्मद् उपपदे समानाधिकरणे स्थानिन्यपि उत्तमसंज्ञकः भवति।

1.4.108.gloss_en: In the **remainder** case, (**the sthānin is**) **prathama** (3rd person).

1.4.109.gloss_en: **Saṃhitā** is (defined as) immediate **contact** with what **follows** — the sandhi / continuous-speech relation.

1.4.11.gloss_en: In a consonant cluster (context), (the vowel/syllable) is (called) guru.

1.4.110.gloss_en: **Virāma** (pause / word boundary) is termed **avasāna** — the non-**saṃhitā** closure of a segment.

1.4.12.gloss_en: And a long vowel (dīrgha) is (called) guru.

1.4.13.gloss_en: That (base) from which an affix-operation is prescribed is called aṅga with respect to that affix (and those beginning with it).
1.4.13.gloss_sa: यस्मात् अङ्गात् प्रत्ययविधिः प्रवर्तते, तदादौ प्रत्यये तद् अङ्ग-संज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.14.gloss_en: That which ends in a sup (nominal) or tiṅ (verbal) affix is called pada.

1.4.15.gloss_en: In the presence of kya-affixes (kye), an n-final form is (treated as) pada.
1.4.15.gloss_sa: क्ये परतः नान्तं शब्दरूपं पदसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.16.gloss_en: And (also) before a sit-affix, the preceding is (called) pada.
1.4.16.gloss_sa: सिति प्रत्यये परतः पूर्वं पदसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.17.gloss_en: When a svādi affix (su etc.) that is not sarvanāmasthāna follows, the preceding is called pada.
1.4.17.gloss_sa: सर्वनामस्थान-भिन्नेषु स्वादिषु परतः पूर्वं पदसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.18.gloss_en: Before yac, (the preceding) is called bhaṃ (bham).

1.4.19.gloss_en: In matvartha context, t-final and s-final (forms) are called bhaṃ.
1.4.19.gloss_sa: तकारान्तं सकारान्तं शब्दरूपं मत्वर्थे प्रत्यये परतो भसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.2.gloss_en: In case of conflict, the later rule is to be applied.

1.4.20.gloss_en: In Vedic usage, the ayasmaya-ādi forms are acceptable (sādhū).
1.4.20.gloss_sa: अयस्मयादीनि शब्दरूपाणि छन्दसि विशये साधूनि भवन्ति।

1.4.21.gloss_en: When plurality is intended, the plural (bahuvacana) is used.

1.4.22.gloss_en: When duality or oneness is intended, (use) the dual or singular respectively.
1.4.22.gloss_sa: द्वित्वे विवक्षिते द्विवचनम्, एकत्वे विवक्षिते एकवचनं च भवति।

1.4.23.gloss_en: (The following rules apply) in the kāraka domain.

1.4.24.gloss_en: In a separation (apāya), the fixed boundary (dhruva) is called apādāna.
1.4.24.gloss_sa: अपाये साध्ये यदवधिभूतं तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.25.gloss_en: For verbs of fearing/protecting, the cause of fear is called apādāna.
1.4.25.gloss_sa: बिभेत्यर्थानां त्रायत्यर्थानां च धातूनां प्रयोगे भयहेतुर् यत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.26.gloss_en: With parā-ji, in the asoḍha (cannot be borne) sense, that kāraka is called apādāna.
1.4.26.gloss_sa: परापूर्वस्य जयतेः प्रयोगे ऽसोढो (सोढुं न शक्यते) यः अर्थः, तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.27.gloss_en: For verbs of preventing/warding off, the īpsita (desired) kāraka is called apādāna.
1.4.27.gloss_sa: वारणार्थानां धातूनां प्रयोगे ईप्सितः यः अर्थः, तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.28.gloss_en: In concealment/obstruction, that (source) by which one wishes non-seeing is called apādāna.
1.4.28.gloss_sa: अन्तर्धिनिमित्ते येन अदर्शनम् (आत्मनः) इच्छति, तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.29.gloss_en: In regulated study (upayoga), the ākhyātā (teacher/expounder) is called apādāna.
1.4.29.gloss_sa: उपयोगे साध्ये य आख्याता (प्रतिपादयिता), तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.3.gloss_en: The feminine words ending in ī or ū are called nadī.

1.4.30.gloss_en: For jani (arising), the prakṛti (cause) of the agent is called apādāna.
1.4.30.gloss_sa: जन्यर्थस्य जन्मनः कर्ता (जायमानः) तस्य या प्रकृतिः कारणं/हेतुः, तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.31.gloss_en: For bhū (in prabhava sense), the prabhava (point of first manifestation/origin) is called apādāna.
1.4.31.gloss_sa: भू-धातोः (प्रभवति ‘प्रथमत उपलभ्यते’) यः कर्त्ता, तस्य यः प्रभवः (उपलभ्यस्थानम्), तत् कारकम् अपादानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.32.gloss_en: That entity toward which the agent aims the karma is called sampradāna.
1.4.32.gloss_sa: करणभूतेन कर्मणा यस्य अभिप्रायं साधयति (यम् उद्दिशति) तत् कारकं सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.33.gloss_en: For verbs of liking/pleasing, the prīyamāṇa (pleased one) is called sampradāna.
1.4.33.gloss_sa: रुच्यर्थानां धातूनां प्रयोगे प्रीयमाणः (तृप्यमाणः) यः अर्थः, तत् कारकं सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.34.gloss_en: With ślāgh/hnuṅ/sthā/śap, the jñīpsyamāna (intended to be informed) is called sampradāna.
1.4.34.gloss_sa: श्लाघ-ह्नुङ्-स्था-शप-धातूनां प्रयोगे ज्ञीप्स्यमानः (ज्ञपयितुम् इष्यमाणः, बोध्यितुम् अभिप्रेतः) यत् कारकं तत् सम्प्रदानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.35.gloss_en: With dhāraya (dhṛ), the uttamarṇa (creditor/lender) is called sampradāna.
1.4.35.gloss_sa: धृञ्/धारयति-प्रयोगे उत्तमर्णः (ऋणदाता, धनस्वामी) यत् कारकं तत् सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.36.gloss_en: With spṛh, the īpsita (desired) is called sampradāna.
1.4.36.gloss_sa: स्पृह (ईप्सायाम्) धातोः प्रयोगे ईप्सितः/अभिप्रेतः यः, तत् कारकं सम्प्रदानसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.37.gloss_en: For krudh/druh/īrṣyā/asūyā-sense verbs, the target toward which kopa is directed is called sampradāna.
1.4.37.gloss_sa: क्रुध-द्रुह-ईर्ष्य-असूयार्थानां धातूनां प्रयोगे यं प्रति कोपः, तत् कारकं सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.38.gloss_en: For krudh/druh when connected with an upasarga, the kopa-target is called karma.
1.4.38.gloss_sa: उपसर्गपूर्वकयोः क्रुध-द्रुहोः प्रयोगे यं प्रति कोपः तत्कारकं कर्मसंज्ञकं भवति (पूर्वेण सम्प्रदानसंज्ञा प्राप्ता, सा कर्मसंज्ञया बाध्यते)।

1.4.39.gloss_en: With rādh/īkṣ, the person whose fate is queried (vipraśna) is called sampradāna.
1.4.39.gloss_sa: राधेः/ईक्षेः प्रयोगे यस्य शुभाशुभं पृच्छ्यते (विप्रश्नः), तत् कारकं सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.4.gloss_en: (Those ī/ū) which are the place of iyāṅ/uvāṅ are not (nadī), except strī.
1.4.4.gloss_sa: इयङुवङस्थानौ यू (स्त्र्याख्यौ) नदीसंज्ञौ न भवतः, स्त्रीशब्दं वर्जयित्वा।

1.4.40.gloss_en: With prati- or āṅ-śru, the kartā of the prior (prompting) action is called sampradāna.
1.4.40.gloss_sa: प्रति/आङ्-पूर्वकशृणोतेः प्रयोगे पूर्वस्याः क्रियायाः कर्ता यत् कारकं तत् सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.41.gloss_en: With anu-/prati-gṛṇ, the kartā of the prior action is called sampradāna.
1.4.41.gloss_sa: अनु-पूर्वस्य प्रति-पूर्वस्य च गृणातेः प्रयोगे पूर्वस्याः क्रियायाः कर्ता यत् कारकं तत् सम्प्रदानसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.42.gloss_en: In accomplishing an action, the most instrumental factor is called karaṇa.
1.4.42.gloss_sa: क्रियासिद्धौ यत् प्रकृष्टोपकारकं विवक्षितम् तत् साधकतमं कारकम् करणसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.43.gloss_en: For div (gaming), the most instrumental factor is called karma (and also karaṇa).
1.4.43.gloss_sa: दिव्-धातोः साधकतमं यत् कारकं, तत् कर्मसंज्ञं भवति, चकारात् करणसंज्ञं च।

1.4.44.gloss_en: In parikrayaṇa (hiring/contracting for wages), the sādhakatama kāraka is optionally called sampradāna.
1.4.44.gloss_sa: परिक्रयणे साधकतमं कारकम् अन्यतरस्यां सम्प्रदानसंज्ञं भवति (पक्षे; अन्यथा करणसंज्ञा)।

1.4.45.gloss_sa: क्रियायाः सिद्धौ यः आधारः, तत् कारकम् अधिकारणसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.46.gloss_en: With adhi + śīṅ/sthā/ās, the ādhāra is called karma.
1.4.46.gloss_sa: अधिपूर्वाणां शीङ्-स्था-आस्-धातूनां प्रयोगे आधारः यत् कारकं, तत् कर्मसंज्ञकं भवति (पूर्वेण अधिकरणसंज्ञा प्राप्ता, सा कर्मसंज्ञया बाध्यते)।

1.4.47.gloss_en: With abhi+ni+viś, the ādhāra is called karma.
1.4.47.gloss_sa: अभिनि-पूर्वस्य विशतेराधारो यः, तत् कारकम् कर्मसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.48.gloss_en: With upa/anu/adhi/āṅ + vas, the ādhāra is called karma.
1.4.48.gloss_sa: अप/अनु/अधि/आङ्-पूर्वकस्य वसतेराधारो यः, तत् कारकं कर्मसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.49.gloss_en: That kāraka which is most desired by the agent (kartṛ) to be attained through the action is called karma.
1.4.49.gloss_sa: क्रियायां सत्यां यत् कर्तुः क्रियया आप्तुम् इष्टतमं कारकं, तत् कर्मसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.5.gloss_en: Optionally, before āmi, the iyāṅ/uvāṅ-sthāna ī/ū forms are (not blocked from) nadī.
1.4.5.gloss_sa: आमि परतः इयङुवङ्स्थानौ यू विभाषा नदीसंज्ञौ न भवतः (अस्त्री एव)।

1.4.50.gloss_en: A non-desired (anīpsita) kāraka which is connected to the action in the same manner (tathā-yukta) as the īpsitatama is also called karma.
1.4.50.gloss_sa: येन प्रकारेण कर्तुरीप्सिततमं क्रियया युज्यते, तेनैव प्रकारेण यदनीप्सितं युक्तं भवति, तस्यापि कर्मसंज्ञा भवति।

1.4.51.gloss_en: A kāraka not specified (akathita) by special kāraka-designations such as apādāna, sampradāna, adhikaraṇa, etc., is called karma (in the listed usage contexts).
1.4.51.gloss_sa: अपादानादिविशेषकथाभिरकथितं यत् कारकं, तत् कर्मसंज्ञं भवति।

1.4.52.gloss_en: In ṇic (causative) of the listed classes (gati/buddhi/pratyavasāna-artha; śabda-karmaka; and akarmaka), the kartā in the base (aṇi) form is called karma in the causative (ṇi) form.
1.4.52.gloss_sa: गत्यर्थबुद्ध्यर्थप्रत्यवसानार्थशब्दकर्मक-अकर्मक-धातूनाम् अण्यन्तावस्थायां यः कर्ता, सः ण्यन्तावस्थायां कर्मसंज्ञकः भवति।

1.4.53.pcd: हृक्रोः · अन्यतरस्याम् · (अणि कर्ता सः णौ कर्म)
1.4.53.gloss_en: For hṛ and kṛ, the kartā in the base (aṇi) form is optionally called karma in the ṇic form (accusative or instrumental on the prayojya-kartṛ).
1.4.53.gloss_sa: हरतेः करोतेश्च अण्यन्तयोः यः कर्ता, सः ण्यन्तयोरन्यतरस्यां कर्मसंज्ञो भवति।

1.4.54.gloss_en: The kāraka that is independent (svatantra)—the primary agent—for the accomplishment of the action is called kartṛ.
1.4.54.gloss_sa: क्रियायाः सिद्धौ स्वतन्त्रं यत् कारकं, तत् कर्तृसंज्ञकं भवति।

1.4.55.gloss_en: The prompter (prayojaka) of the svatantra kartṛ is called hetu, and by ca is also called kartṛ.
1.4.55.gloss_sa: तस्य स्वतन्त्रकर्तुः यः प्रयोजकः, तस्य हेतुसंज्ञा भवति; चकारात् कर्तृसंज्ञा च।

1.4.56.gloss_en: Adhikāra: (the following rules concern) nipātas before īśvara (in the authoritative sūtra sequence).
1.4.56.gloss_sa: प्रागीश्वरात् निपातानां विषये अधिकारः — अनन्तराणि सूत्राणि निपातसंज्ञाविषयाणि।

1.4.57.gloss_en: Cādi items are called nipāta when they do not denote dravya (substance); when they denote dravya they are not nipāta by this rule.
1.4.57.gloss_sa: चादयो निपातसंज्ञकाः भवन्ति, यदि सत्त्वे अर्थे (द्रव्यवाचिनः) न वर्तन्ते।

1.4.58.gloss_en: Prādi items are called nipāta when they do not denote dravya (same asattva condition as 1.4.57 for cādi).

1.4.59.gloss_en: Prādi items are called upasarga when yoked to the action (verbal collocation with the dhātu they modify).

1.4.6.gloss_en: Under ṅit, the (related) short i/u also (optionally) have the nadī designation.
1.4.6.gloss_sa: ङिति परतो ह्रस्वश्च (य्वोः सम्बन्धी) स्त्र्याख्यः विभाषा नदीसंज्ञः भवति।

1.4.60.gloss_en: Gati-gaṇa items are also called upasarga when yoked to the action (same kriyā-yoga condition as 1.4.59).

1.4.61.gloss_en: Ūryādi-listed items, cvi-endings, and ḍāca-endings are also called gati when yoked to the action (same kriyā-yoga condition as 1.4.59–60).

1.4.62.gloss_en: Onomatopoeic / imitation forms with **iti** following immediately are also called gati when yoked to the action.

1.4.63.gloss_en: The forms **sat** and **asatī** are called **gati** in contexts of respect and disrespect when yoked to the action.

1.4.64.gloss_en: **alam** is called **gati** when used in an ornamenting sense, yoked to the verbal action.

1.4.65.gloss_en: **Antar**/**antaḥ** is called **gati** when used in connection with **aparigraha**, yoked to the verbal action.

1.4.66.gloss_en: **Kaṇe** and **manasī** forms are **gati** when used in the sense of **śraddhāpratīghāta**, yoked to the action.
1.4.66.gloss_sa: कणे मनसी श्रद्धाप्रतीघाते क्रियायोगे गतिसंज्ञे भवतः।

1.4.67.gloss_en: **Puraḥ** / **puro** is called **avyaya** when yoked to the verbal action.

1.4.68.gloss_en: **Astam** is also called **avyaya** when yoked to the verbal action (anuvṛtti of **avyayam** from 1.4.67).

8.4.41.gloss_en: Tripāḍī saṃhitā: under the running stoḥ/ṭu thread, dental s and dental t-varga (त् थ् द् ध् न्) become the corresponding ṣṭu (ष् ट् ठ् ड् ढ् ण्) when immediately followed by a ṣṭu consonant.

8.4.42.gloss_en: Tripāḍī boundary restriction: at padānta ṭ, the downstream dental→ṣṭu effects are blocked.

8.4.43.gloss_en: Tripāḍī saṃhitā: dental t-varga (त् थ् द् ध् न्) becomes the corresponding retroflex before ष्.

8.4.44.gloss_en: Tripāḍī saṃhitā: s becomes ś before n (śa-ādeśa).

8.4.45.gloss_en: In saṃhitā, before a nasal (anunāsika), a preceding consonant may optionally be replaced by the corresponding nasal.
8.4.45.gloss_sa: संहितायाम् अनुनासिके परतः यरः अनुनासिकादेशो वा भवति।

8.4.46.gloss_en: In saṃhitā, after a vowel, when r or h follows, the following yar consonant is doubled (dvitva).
8.4.46.gloss_sa: संहितायाम् अचः परे रेफे/हकारे सति तयोः परस्य यरः द्विर्वचनं भवति।

8.4.47.gloss_en: In a non-vowel environment (**an-aci**), (the doubling of the following consonant after a vowel) also applies.

8.4.48.gloss_en: In **ākrōśa**, when **ādīnī** follows, the (dvitva) doubling does not occur for **putra**.

8.4.50.gloss_en: In consonant clusters of three or more consonants, according to Śākaṭāyana, the doubling (dvitva) does not occur.
8.4.50.gloss_sa: त्रिप्रभृतिषु संयुक्तेषु शाकटायनमतेन द्वित्वं न भवति।

8.4.51.gloss_en: According to Śākalya, (the dvitva) doubling does not occur everywhere.

8.4.52.gloss_en: After a long vowel (**dīrgha**), according to the ācāryas, the (dvitva) doubling does not occur.
8.4.52.gloss_sa: दीर्घात् परतः आचार्यमतेन द्वित्वं न भवति।

8.4.53.gloss_en: When a **Jal** consonant is followed by a **JaS** consonant, it is replaced by the corresponding **jaS**.

8.4.55.gloss_en: In saṃhitā, a preceding jhal consonant changes to its car (voiceless) counterpart before a following khar consonant.

8.4.57.gloss_en: For a non-pragṛhya (apragṛhya) aṇ-vowel at pause/end (avasāna), there is optionally an anunāsika (nasalized) substitute.
8.4.57.gloss_sa: अप्रगृह्यसंज्ञस्य अणः (अ/इ/उ—सवर्णसहितस्य) अवसाने वर्तमानस्य वा अनुनासिकादेशो भवति।

8.4.58.gloss_en: In saṃhitā, anusvāra becomes the homorganic nasal (parasavarṇa) before a following yayi consonant.

8.4.59.gloss_en: At padānta, the parasavarṇa nasal (from 8.4.58) may optionally be replaced back by anusvāra.

8.4.60.gloss_en: Before ल्, a preceding ta-varga consonant (त् थ् द् ध् न्) is replaced by ल्.

8.4.61.gloss_en: For the preverb उद्, before स्था/स्तम्भ, the junction is adjusted to yield utt(h/...) surface.

8.4.62.gloss_en: After a stop (jhay), initial ह् may optionally be replaced by the corresponding varga aspirate (घ्/झ्/ढ्/ध्/भ् etc.).

8.4.63.gloss_en: At a saṃhitā boundary, initial श् may optionally become छ् (and before that, ta-varga may surface as palatal in the corpus forms).

8.4.64.gloss_en: In saṃhitā, after a consonant, when a yam is followed by a yam, the first yam is optionally deleted.
8.4.64.gloss_sa: संहितायाम् हलः परेषां यमां यमि परतः (अन्यतरस्याम्) लोपो भवति।

8.4.65.gloss_en: In saṃhitā, (optionally) delete a jhaR consonant when followed by a savarṇa jhaR consonant.
8.4.65.gloss_sa: संहितायाम् हलः परस्य झरः झरि सवर्णे परतः (अन्यतरस्याम्) लोपो भवति।

8.4.68.gloss_en: Metalinguistic (iti-citation): the two cited अ sounds — vivṛta and saṃvṛta — are jointly named so vowel/śikṣā rules referring to अ may cover the kaṇṭhya pair; tripāḍī engine pass records adjacent अ/ā
